items.description: LMDEC LTD is a family-run residential building and renovation contractor based in South Croydon serving South and South West London (within ~30 minutes of the office); not an architect, estate agent or supplier, and does not work outside this area

Business model: fixed-price contracts, one project manager per client with weekly meetings, in-house trades, maximum three concurrent projects; free site visit and written fixed-price quote within 48 hours
Gas and electrical work is done by individually qualified Gas Safe registered and NICEIC certified subcontractors; LMDEC itself does not hold these registrations
Company history: founder Lukasz Mazurek has ~two decades of trade experience, traded as sole trader from 2014, incorporated LMDEC LTD in 2018 (company no. 11635394); these dates are not contradictory

All published prices exclude VAT; typical ranges e.g. kitchen £15k–£80k+, bathroom £6k–£35k+, loft conversions rooflight £40k–£65k to mansard £90k+, single-storey extension £80k–£180k; professional fees separate and inner London 10–20% higher
Warranty and insurance: 2-year written workmanship warranty with 6-month return visit, 10-year waterproofing guarantee on wet rooms/tanked floors, £2m public liability insurance
Contact: Suite 173, Capital Business Centre, 22 Carlton Road, South Croydon CR2 0BS; phone 0204 577 2001 / 07472 883 901; info@lmdec.co.uk; open Mon–Fri 08:00–18:00, Sat 09:00–14:00
Reviews: 54 verified five-star reviews aggregated across Google, Trustindex, Trustpilot and Yell (not Google-only); Best of Houzz 2026 award
